primary_unit: independent evolution seed cluster, with all30 tasks sharing that seed
primary_bound: one-sided97.5% Clopper-Pearson upper limit on any-task baseline-success loss per seed; negative of this upper limit bounds every fixed task success difference below
unknowns: all missing/failed/incomplete paired comparisons count as potential losses; no complete-case deletion
descriptive: report per-task paired gains/losses and conservative two-sided95% difference intervals; gen0 and subsequent final successes separately
sample_size: freeze globally by TRAINING runtime forecast before generating fresh data; prefer80 seeds if feasible, otherwise report underpowered inference honestly
scope: fixed30 tasks and one pinned disjoint training/test split; no universal equivalence, new-domain or paper-replication claim
